title: MCP Heartbeat 0.1
description: A heartbeat is a short-lived, ordered liveness lease published by one participant. It asserts only that the participant was alive and publishing at issued_at and claims the window to expires_at. It never asserts readiness, health, authorization, correctness, or task success. extension_version is independent of any MCP protocol revision.

extension_version.description: Version of THIS heartbeat contract. Independent of the MCP protocol era; a consumer that supports 0.1 reads only documents declaring 0.1.

node_id.description: Participant identity: whatever publishes exactly one totally-ordered heartbeat stream. Wire key retained at 0.1; the normative term is 'participant'. Renaming to participant_id is deferred to extension_version 1.0.

boot_id.description: Epoch identity: minted once per process start, never reused, derived, or predicted. Wire key retained at 0.1; the normative term is 'epoch'. Renaming to epoch_id is deferred to extension_version 1.0.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing counter scoped to (participant, epoch). Resets with the epoch.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant at which the participant issued this heartbeat.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant after which this heartbeat proves nothing. Must be strictly after issued_at and no more than 3600s later.

extensions.description: Optional, safely ignorable data. Every key must be namespaced (contain a dot). Nothing here may participate in core freshness validation.

\\..description: Namespaced top-level extension members are permitted and ignored by the core.
